params.caption: 🕹️ Sony patents a neck collar that blows air to boost immersion A newly spotted Sony patent describes a collar worn around the neck that blows air on the player to "increase the sense of immersion". GamesRadar+ points out it could make VR horror games a lot scarier — imagine a breath on your neck at the worst possible moment. As always with patents, there's no guarantee it ever becomes a real product. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 01:29 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👥 @PlayStation 😱 Would you wear it? React 👍 or 👎 and tell us in the comments #Sony #PSVR2 #PlayStation #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
